body:
Track 5 follow-up to `simdesign-dfm`. A tension plate with one required hole is sized for minimum mass under three stress models (net section, Kt = 3, 2D FE over d/W) and per-process hole rules. Each design is re-checked by FE. Findings: ignoring the concentration under-sizes by 1.9–2.7×; Kt = 3 is safe but 8–26% heavier for FDM; where the centre-to-edge rule binds (CNC, laser from 8 mm, casting from 8 mm) the stress model is irrelevant.

9 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok. Stylised: assumed rule values and load, 2D plane stress, mesh about 1% low. The finite-width Kt polynomial and the Kirsch citation are from memory and flagged unverified in the README. Builds on none of the labs in `prompt.md`.
